expenses.reportNotEditable: This report can no longer be edited. Only a draft or a returned report can be changed.
expenses.documentsClosed: Documents cannot be added once the report has been decided.
expenses.documentsRereadClosed: Documents cannot be re-read once the report has been decided.
expenses.taxExceedsAmount: Tax of {tax} exceeds the expense amount of {amount}. Tax cannot be more than what was paid.
expenses.taxExceedsAmountAt: {merchant}: tax of {tax} exceeds the expense amount of {amount}. Tax cannot be more than what was paid.

fx.overrideNotSubmitted: The FX override can only be set or cleared while the report is submitted and awaiting a decision. Once decided, its amounts are what was approved.
fx.rateOutOfBounds: The rate must be a positive number no greater than {max, number}.
fx.rateFarFromDaily: Rate {rate} is more than {band}× away from the daily rate {reference} for {from}→{home}. A statement rate differs from the daily rate by a few percent, not by multiples.
fx.rateFarFromPrior: {base}→{quote} was last recorded at {prior} on {on}. {rate} is {deviation}% away from that — more than the {bound}% a rate may move without a reason. If the earlier rate was the wrong one, add this one with a reason saying so.

ledger.adoptUnmapped: Nothing in VeloExpense is mapped to the NetSuite record “{value}”, so there is no value to adopt. Map it on the matching admin page first, or choose “Keep VeloExpense, fix NetSuite” to correct NetSuite instead.
ledger.referenceInUse: This reference cannot be removed because records still point at it. The list below shows exactly where. Nothing was deleted and nothing was unmapped.
ledger.referenceActive: Only an inactive reference can be removed. Deactivate this one first, then delete it.
ledger.reconcileNotImported: This charge was entered by hand in VeloExpense, not imported from the card feed, so there is nothing in NetSuite to reconcile it with.
ledger.reconcileProcessing: VeloExpense is posting this charge to NetSuite right now. Wait for the result before marking it as posted by hand.
ledger.reconcileAlreadyReconciled: This charge is already marked as posted in NetSuite by hand.
ledger.reconcileChangedConcurrently: This charge changed while you were marking it, so nothing was recorded. Refresh to see its current state.

expenseCategories.nsCategoryMissing: That NetSuite expense category is no longer in the synced list. Run a reference sync, or choose another one.
expenseCategories.nsCategoryInactive: That NetSuite expense category is inactive in NetSuite. Choose an active one, or clear the override to match by name.

billing.expenseLimitReached: This organization’s plan allows {limit, number} expenses a year, and that many have been added in the last twelve months. Your drafts are saved — an administrator can change the plan from the billing settings.
